capabilities: Store anniversaries in note frontmatter, including unknown years (????, 0000, xxxx, yyyy)
Render a sorted anniversary list in a note via an anniversaries code block
Filter anniversaries by date ranges using Tasks-style happens syntax
Show an (X years ago) label for anniversaries with known years
Override the reference date with a today option in the code block
disambiguation: Does not send notifications or pop-ups; it renders an anniversary list inside notes via a code block.
extras: Supports only the Gregorian calendar and only frontmatter entries, not anniversaries written in the note body; the README includes a contributor-focused build and release section.
intentEvidence: Plugins such as TASKS require full date specifications (including year).
motivation: The author built it because plugins such as TASKS require full date specifications including the year, and plugins like the DATA plugin are too heavyweight for a simple anniversary list.
problem: Obsidian has no simple way to track recurring annual dates: the Tasks plugin requires full dates with a year and only generates recurring tasks after the current one is checked off, and Dataview is heavyweight for a simple anniversary list.

relations.evidence: Plugins such as TASKS require full date specifications (including year).
Plugins such as the DATA plugin are much more heavyweight and require an unreasonable amount of coding

summary: Reads anniversary dates from note frontmatter and lists them in notes, sorted by month and day, with Tasks-style date filters.
